name: Voyager
bio: Archetype: Crowd-Control, Crit-Rate Up, Damage Reflect, DEF Buff. ⌽ Can inflict strong debuffs; [Confusion], [Silence] and [Seal]. ⌽ S2 grants allies [Sturdiness] and [Interstellar Blessing], reducing DMG Taken and countering with Genesis damage when attacked. ⌽ Ultimate reduces enemy Moxie and deals additional damage against enemies with [Confusion].
